```yaml
name: Verify DCO Sign-off

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-dco:
    name: Check DCO Sign-off
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check commits for DCO sign-off
        id: dco-check
        run: |
          set -e
          
          # Get the base branch (usually master or main)
          BASE_BRANCH="${GITHUB_BASE_REF}"
          
          # Get all commits in the PR that are not merge commits
          COMMITS=$(git log --no-merges --format="%H" "${BASE_BRANCH}..HEAD")
          
          # Check each commit for DCO sign-off
          MISSING_SIGNS=()
          for COMMIT in $COMMITS; do
            # Check if the commit message contains Signed-off-by
            if ! git show --format="%B" --no-color "$COMMIT" | grep -q "Signed-off-by:"; then
              MISSING_SIGNS+=("$COMMIT")
            fi
          done
          
          # If there are missing signatures, fail the check
          if [ ${#MISSING_SIGNS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "❌ Some commits are missing DCO sign-off:"
            for COMMIT in "${MISSING_SIGNS[@]}"; do
              echo "  - $COMMIT"
            done
            echo ""
            echo "To fix this, please amend your commits with the DCO sign-off:"
            echo "  git commit --amend -s"
            echo ""
            echo "Or for multiple commits:"
            echo "  git rebase -i <base-branch>"
            echo "  # Mark commits as 'edit'"
            echo "  # For each commit, run: git commit --amend -s"
            echo "  # Then continue rebase: git rebase --continue"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "✅ All commits have DCO sign-off"
```
